---
title: "Synthetic study report"
lang: en
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: true
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
  docx: default
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("/checks/lib/helpers.R")
library(ggplot2)
d <- patients()
```

## Patients

```{r}
#| label: tbl-patients
#| tbl-cap: "Patients by group"
gtsummary::tbl_summary(d, by = group, include = c(age, sex, bmi, y)) |> gtsummary::add_p()
```

## Outcome

```{r}
#| label: fig-outcome
#| fig-cap: "Outcome by age and group"
ggplot(d, aes(age, y, colour = group)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.4) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model
#| tbl-cap: "Linear model"
fit <- lm(y ~ group + age + bmi, data = d)
knitr::kable(broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE), digits = 3)
```

The estimated treatment effect is `r round(coef(fit)[["grouptreatment"]], 2)`.
